question: What characterizes the reality in which consciousness-bliss shines?
premises: In that reality there is no divided state having an inert form.
In that reality there is no division whatsoever.
That reality shines forth on all sides.
inference: Therefore the locus of consciousness-bliss is an undivided, non-inert reality that shines everywhere without limitation.
plain_english: Where there is no divided state of inert form, where there is no division at all, and which shines forth on every side.
